primary.title: Höglandsleden etapp HÖ4 Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum - En del av Smålandsleden
Höglandsleden etapp HÖ4 Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum - En del av Smålandsleden

officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: HÖ4 runs south from Valbacken above Ingatorp to Lilla Bjälkerum. The official description starts with the Valbacken view over Ingatorp, Ingatorp church and Brusaån valley, then follows the trail through Ingatorp and a former peat bog where the ground can be wet. It continues to Vada skure and Kolebäcken, passes Kråkshult, Fågelhult and Åsa, and ends at Lilla Bjälkerum by remains from an old mill and later industrial activity.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: This main-loop stage leaves Valbacken above Ingatorp and soon passes through Ingatorp before turning into quieter forest, bog and rural country. The section has a real wet-weather character around the former peat-moss area and Vada skure/Kolebäcken, then opens into villages, gravel roads and cultural landscape around Kråkshult, Fågelhult and Åsa before reaching Lilla Bjälkerum. Water and transit are weak at the Bjälkerum end; plan carrying water and arranging pickup, taxi or a long access leg unless continuing on HÖ5.

start.label: Valbacken
start.notes: The GPX starts at the Valbacken HÖ2/HÖ3/HÖ4 junction and is about 56 m from the Valbacken ledentré marker. Use the GPX endpoint for route topology and the ledentré marker for access/facility metadata.

end.label: Lilla Bjälkerum / Bjälkerum ledentré HÖ4/HÖ5
end.notes: The GPX end is about 1.8 m from the Bjälkerum ledentré marker and about 2.5 m from the HÖ5 GPX start. The official section endpoint is Lilla Bjälkerum, while the official access POI is named Bjälkerum ledentré HÖ4/HÖ5.

ferry.notes: No ferry or rowboat access applies to this inland section.

facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node and official Valbacken shelter text
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe/service building at Valbacken. Official shelter page says toilet and water are in the basement of Toppstugan, but the toilet is closed in winter.
facilities.pendingReason: Useful endpoint service metadata, but import should preserve seasonal/opening-hour dependency and deduplicate with HÖ2/HÖ3.

facilities.name: Valbacken viewpoint
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 2353537271; official HÖ4/Valbacken description confirms view over Ingatorp

facilities.name: Regnbågsdalen Café & Guesthouse
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM way 598500462 and Visit Småland service page
facilities.description: Commercial cafe/guesthouse in Ingatorp near the route through town.
facilities.caveats: Commercial/opening-hour dependent. Water/food only when open.

facilities.name: Ingatorpsbadet
facilities.description: Off-route bathing place near Ingatorp with grill, toilet, changing rooms and jetty according to Naturkartan.
facilities.caveats: Off-route side trip from Valbacken/Ingatorp. No drinking-water claim; lake water is surface water only.

facilities.name: Ingatorps kyrka
facilities.description: Church in Ingatorp highlighted by the official HÖ4 description. The current church was built after a 1914 fire, with an older triumph crucifix retained.
facilities.pendingReason: Cultural route context; no confirmed public hiker service/water to import as a facility.

facilities.name: Vadholmen shelter
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 7114540544 and field report corroboration
facilities.description: On-route shelter/rest point around Vadholmen. Field report found the shelter; OSM also maps a shelter/rest point.
facilities.pendingReason: OSM carries a verify-on-ground style caveat and the field report did not find all listed amenities such as trash bin. No water or toilet confirmed.

facilities.name: Vada skure / Kolebäcken ravine
facilities.coordinateSource: Approximate GPX-derived coordinate from facilities lane and official HÖ4 description
facilities.description: Ravine with Kolebäcken in the bottom, highlighted by the official HÖ4 description for its rich flora. Field reports say the harder ravine option is short and should not be oversold.
facilities.pendingReason: Approximate coordinate and likely best as a route description note rather than a standalone facility. Kolebäcken is not a potable-water source.

facilities.name: Kråkshult church/access cluster
facilities.coordinateSource: Facilities lane Outdooractive parking note; Kråkshult church OSM nearby
facilities.description: Kråkshult village/church area is passed by HÖ4. A third-party source indicates possible parking/access near the avenue, but it is not an official Smålandsleden parking object.
facilities.pendingReason: Access/parking is third-party and should be verified before import. No confirmed hiker services or water.

facilities.name: Fågelhult and Åsa village context
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM place node for Fågelhult; Åsa place node nearby at 57.540509, 15.394209
facilities.description: Villages described by the official HÖ4 text, including Fågelhult as a row village from the 1830s and Åsa separated by Kyrkebäcken.
facilities.caveats: Route-description context only; no confirmed hiker services/water.

facilities.name: Bjälkerum ledentré HÖ4/HÖ5
facilities.description: Official HÖ4/HÖ5 connection entrance at Bjälkerum/Lilla Bjälkerum, where the official description notes old mill and industrial remains.
facilities.caveats: Entrance only. Official page does not list parking, toilet or water.

facilities.name: Lilla Bjälkerum shelter
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan official shelter marker; OSM and field report nearby
facilities.description: Shelter and grill place on a short detour from the Bjälkerum endpoint. Eksjö municipality lists it among grill places maintained by the municipality.
facilities.pendingReason: Import likely appropriate as endpoint shelter/fireplace, but field reports in 2020 noted possible damp/leaky roof, no firewood during overnight, and floodwater near the raised shelter. No toilet or potable water confirmed.

waterSources.name: Valbackens Toppstuga water
waterSources.reliability: medium when open; unavailable in winter per official page
waterSources.notes: Official Valbacken shelter page says water is accessible at Toppstugan toilet, but the toilet is closed in winter. Treat as endpoint service only.

waterSources.name: Streams, bog ditches and Bjälkerumsån along HÖ4
waterSources.notes: HÖ4 passes wet/boggy areas, Kolebäcken and water near Lilla Bjälkerum, but no reliable potable mid-stage source was found. Carry water and treat all surface water if used.

camping.notes: No HÖ4-specific campsite or camping ban was found. General Swedish allemansrätten guidance applies: small-scale tenting is generally allowed for one or two nights if it does not damage or disturb; longer stays or groups need landowner permission. Valbacken, Vadholmen and Lilla Bjälkerum are shelter/rest candidates, but Vadholmen and Lilla Bjälkerum need condition verification.

shelter.notes: Official shelters are confirmed at Valbacken and Lilla Bjälkerum. Vadholmen is a strong pending on-route shelter/rest candidate from OSM plus field report but needs verification.

fire.notes: Valbacken and Lilla Bjälkerum have shelter/fireplace or grill-place support. Current Länsstyrelsen fire-ban layer reportedly returned no Eksjö fire ban at query time on 2026-04-29, but this must not be hard-coded; fire-ban status is dynamic and stricter bans can prohibit prepared fireplaces too.

toilets.notes: Valbacken has a toilet in Toppstugan but the official page says it is closed in winter. Ingatorpsbadet has a toilet off route near Ingatorp. No confirmed toilet was found at Vadholmen or Lilla Bjälkerum.

protectedAreas.name: No formal HÖ4 protected-area overlap found in research pass
protectedAreas.notes: Rules lane reported no NVR/Natura/protected-area or access-ban intersection for HÖ4. Nearest noted protected object was Högaskögle about 1.6 km away. HÖ5 after Lilla Bjälkerum passes protected areas, but do not attach those restrictions to HÖ4.

dogs.notes: General Swedish dog-control rules apply. Dogs must be under extra control from 1 March to 20 August and should be leashed around wildlife, livestock, farms and villages; Naturvårdsverket recommends choosing another route where livestock with young animals are present.

huntingForestryAndLivestock.notes: No HÖ4-specific hunting or forestry closure was found on 2026-04-29. Public access remains during hunting, but deliberately disturbing hunting/fishing is prohibited. Follow temporary signage near farms, forestry work and hunting areas, close gates and keep dogs controlled near livestock.

currentClosures.notes: No official HÖ4 closure or reroute notice was found on Smålandsleden/Naturkartan. Naturkartan API closure/status fields were reported null. Nearby HÖ2 has a reroute warning before Hässleåsa, but that does not apply to HÖ4.

hazards.name: Wet former peat bog / Torvströmossen area after Ingatorp
hazards.notes: The official HÖ4 description warns that the former peat-moss area after Ingatorp can be wet. Multiple field reports from 2020 and 2022 corroborate wet ground, ditches, small bridges and bog character.

hazards.name: Vada skure / Kolebäcken footing and junctions
hazards.notes: Field reports say the harder ravine option is short and not especially dramatic, but the area can still require attention to footing and junctions, especially in darkness.

hazards.name: Weak Lilla Bjälkerum public transport
hazards.notes: The nearest practical official bus candidates are around Karlstorp, over 7 km straight-line and over 10 km by road from the endpoint, with sparse line 335 service. Plan pickup, taxi, bike drop, continuation on HÖ5, or a long road access leg.

hazards.name: Water scarcity
hazards.notes: No reliable potable water was found between Valbacken and Lilla Bjälkerum. Carry enough water and treat natural water if used.

fireBanPolicy.notes: Normal and stricter fire bans differ. Prepared fireplaces may be allowed under some ordinary bans but can be prohibited under stricter bans. Check current Länsstyrelsen/municipal fire-ban status on the hiking date.

conditionReports.source: Hemomkringvandring: Höglandsleden Ingatorp till Vada skure/ravin t.o.r.
conditionReports.summary: Partial field report around Ingatorp to Vada skure. Confirms the wet/boggy character, ditches, small bridges and route-finding caution at forest-road junctions, especially in darkness.
conditionReports.importImpact: Use for wet terrain and navigation caution; not a closure or current condition.

conditionReports.source: Hemomkringvandring: Höglandsleden Stora Bjälkerum till Ingatorp 23 km
conditionReports.summary: Full or near-full reverse-direction field report under older Stora Bjälkerum-Ingatorp naming. Reports clear waymarking, mixed gravel/asphalt/farm landscape and forest/bog paths, wet but passable sections with sturdy boots, Vadholmen shelter, and no reliable water/service assumptions.
conditionReports.importImpact: Strong route-character corroboration. Do not use older endpoint naming/distance as canonical.

conditionReports.summary: Revisit around Ingatorp/Vada confirms mosses, small bridges and peat-bog character. Useful more recent corroboration of the official wet-area warning.

HÖ5-oriented report includes Lilla Bjälkerum endpoint shelter notes: short detour to shelter/grill, possible leaky/damp shelter condition, no firewood during overnight and floodwater near but not inside the raised shelter.
conditionReports.importImpact: Use as Lilla Bjälkerum shelter currentness caveat; do not suppress official shelter.

sourceContradictions.details: Official URL slug says ho4-ingatorp-lilla-bjalkerum, but the official title and inventory say Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum. The GPX starts at Valbacken.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Use current official title/endpoints and keep slug only as source identifier.

sourceContradictions.details: The section endpoint is officially Lilla Bjälkerum, while the official access POI is named Bjälkerum ledentré HÖ4/HÖ5.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Low-medium. Use Lilla Bjälkerum for section endpoint and Bjälkerum ledentré for the access POI.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM relation 10553871 and third-party route apps use older Ingatorp - Stora Bjälkerum / Delsträcka 6 naming and longer distances around 21-24 km, while current official HÖ4 is Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum, 20.5 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: High. Use official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan HÖ4 and GPX/API as canonical.

sourceContradictions.details: Local v2 API and geometry-lane checks found an exact GPX/API match with 1,059 vertices. One official-source lane note using a v3.2 endpoint mentioned denser GPX sampling than API shape. Use the downloaded GPX and v2 API geometry as the canonical import source and recheck API version at import time.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Low-medium. Canonical GPX is stable and navigation-grade; API-version behavior should be documented.

sourceContradictions.details: Bjälkerum ledentré is official, but the official page marks entrance only, not parking. Field/third-party notes suggest possible roadside or grass parking, but this is not official.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Do not import formal endpoint parking at Bjälkerum unless verified.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/Naturkartan/Eksjö sources support Lilla Bjälkerum shelter/grill, but 2020 field reports mention possible damp/leaky condition and no firewood. Vadholmen is field/OSM-supported but not official and carries verification caveats.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Import official Lilla Bjälkerum with caveat; keep Vadholmen pending until verified.

agents.result: Confirmed official HÖ4 metadata, description order, topology, endpoint markers, official POIs/facilities, and no official HÖ4 closure/reroute.
Confirmed official GPX/API as navigation-grade: 1 segment, 1,059 points, 20.446 km, clean continuity with HÖ2/HÖ3/HÖ5, and stale OSM relation 10553871 context.

Collected shared Valbacken facilities, Ingatorp service/access candidates, Vadholmen pending shelter, Kråkshult/Fågelhult/Åsa context, Bjälkerum ledentré and Lilla Bjälkerum shelter/fireplace caveats.
Confirmed strong Valbacken/Ingatorp start access and very weak Lilla Bjälkerum endpoint transit via Karlstorp line 335, plus official Valbacken parking and no official Bjälkerum parking.

Found Hemomkringvandring and route-app reports confirming wet/bog caveats, mixed road/forest character, generally clear marking, Lilla Bjälkerum shelter condition caveats, water scarcity and stale route-app naming.
Found no HÖ4 protected-area/access-ban overlap or official closure/reroute; added fire-ban, dog/livestock, hunting/forestry, wet terrain and water caveats.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Strong enough for research-ready normalization with caveats. No second agent batch needed now because official metadata, geometry, endpoint coordinates, facilities, weak transit/access, field conditions and rules are adequately covered. Remaining weaknesses are normalization or currentness checks: Vadholmen and Lilla Bjälkerum shelter condition, exact Bjälkerum parking policy, poor endpoint transit, Valbacken service seasonality and API-version linework behavior.
